items.title: Approval of Fiscal Year 2028 Budget Calendar
items.body:
MEETING DATE:
8/18/2026
TOPIC:
Approve Fiscal Year 2028 Budget Calendar
POLICY ALIGNMENT:
DB, Annual Budget
BACKGROUND:
The state code requires that the school board present a balanced budget, in which revenues equal
expenditures, to the city and county on or before April 1st. The FY28 budget year covers the period from July
1, 2027 through June 30, 2028.
The three primary phases in the budget development process include: 1) Superintendent's Proposed Budget
(administrative recommendation presented to the school board); 2) School Board Proposed Budget (school
board recommendation to the James City County Board of Supervisors and the Williamsburg City Council);
and, 3) School Board Adopted Budget (school board adopted budget based upon funding
authorization/appropriation by the county and city).
The process includes three opportunities to gather community input, one in November to discuss the Capital
Improvement Plan (CIP), one in January prior to the development of the Superintendent's Proposed Operating
Budget and another in February prior to approval of the School Board Proposed Operating Budget.
Williamsburg-James City County Public Schools' personnel will develop the CIP in September and October.
The operating budget development process starts with reviewing departmental and school budget requests
beginning in November using the WJCCPS Strategic Plan to provide direction.
The Superintendent's Proposed Budget is developed and presented to the school board in February. After a
public hearing on the budget, the school board approves the School Board Proposed Budget in March and
refers it to the James City County Board of Supervisors and the Williamsburg City Council for consideration.
The localities must approve the appropriation for the school system no later than May 15th or within 30 days of
the receipt by the county or municipality of the estimates of state funds, whichever occurs later. Based upon
approved funding by the county and city, the school board makes any necessary adjustments and approves an
Adopted Budget in May.
The FY28 Budget Calendar is included for review.
RATIONALE:
The state code requires that the school board present a balanced budget.
SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCE(S):
The Superintendent's Proposed Budget will be officially presented to the school board in February 2027,
pursuant to § 22.1-92 of the Code of Virginia. The school board will then approve its proposed budget by April
1st, pursuant to § 15.2-2503 of the Code of Virginia. After the localities approve the appropriation for the school
system in May 2027, the school board will make any necessary adjustments and adopt a final budget in May
2027.



COST BUDGETED:
As presented in budget documents.
ALTERNATIVES:
1. Approve the superintendent’s recommendation.
2. Do not approve the superintendent’s recommendation.
SUPERINTENDENT’S RECOMMENDATION:
The superintendent recommends that the school board approve the FY28 budget calendar as presented.
DATA SOURCE:
Rene Ewing, Chief Financial Officer
RECOMMENDED ACTION:
Move to approve the Fiscal Year 2028 budget calendar as presented.

items.title: Approval of Authorization to Permit City/County Use of School Buses
items.body:
MEETING DATE:
8/18/2026
TOPIC:
Approve Authorization to Permit City/County Use of School Buses
POLICY ALIGNMENT:
BBA, School Board Powers and Duties
BACKGROUND:
Periodically, WJCC Schools receives requests for transportation from the City of Williamsburg and James City
County. The Transportation Department assists in the transport of the JCC Parks and Recreation
programs/participants to and from summer activities and between locations during the school year. § 22.1-182
of the Code of Virginia requires school board approval of such use.
RATIONALE:
N/A
SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCE(S):
§ 22.1-182 of the Code of Virginia states in part: "The school board of any school division may enter into
agreements with the governing body of any county, city or town in the school division, any state agency or any
agency established or identified pursuant to United States Public Law 89-73 or any law amendatory or
supplemental thereto providing for the use of the school buses of such school division by such agency or by
departments, boards, commissions or officers of such county, city or town for public purposes, including
transportation for the elderly. Each such agreement shall provide for reimbursing the school board in full for the
proportionate share of any and all costs, both fixed and variable, of such buses incurred by such school board
attributable to the use of such buses pursuant to such an agreement. The governing body, state agency or
agency established or identified pursuant to United States Public Law 89-73 or any law amendatory or
supplemental thereto shall indemnify and hold harmless the school board from any and all liability of the school
board by virtue of use of such buses pursuant to an agreement authorized herein."
COST BUDGETED:
Costs associated with the use of school buses by the city and county are paid by the appropriate governing
body and do not accrue to the school division.
ALTERNATIVES:
1. Approve the superintendent’s recommendation.
2. Do not approve the superintendent’s recommendation.
SUPERINTENDENT’S RECOMMENDATION:
The superintendent recommends that the school board approve the authorization to permit use of school
buses by the city and county for the 2026-2027 school year.
DATA SOURCE:
Marcellus Snipes, Senior Director for Operations
RECOMMENDED ACTION:

items.title: Approval of Request for a Permanent Easement at Toano Middle School of Real Property to Virginia Department of Environmental Quality
items.body:
MEETING DATE:
8/18/2026
TOPIC:
Approve Request for a Permanent Easement at Toano Middle School, James City County Real Estate Tax
Parcel No. 1240100051, of Real Property to Virginia Department of Environmental Quality
POLICY ALIGNMENT:
BBA, School Board Powers and Duties
BACKGROUND:
The Virginia Department of Environmental Quality is requesting that WJCC Schools provide an easement in
perpetuity. The request is to support the funded expansion of Virginia DEQ statewide network of groundwater
observation wells. DEQ has contracted with the U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) to install between 30 and 40
new State Observation Wells (SOW). Data from these observation wells ensure informed decision about the
management of water resources in Virginia.
A subset of the planned SOW’s are specifically designed to monitor chloride concentrations in groundwater
(i.e., to monitor potential saltwater movement) within Virginia’s Coastal Plain aquifer system, as described by
McFarland (2015, see attached). As part of this effort, DEQ identified locations upgradient of known pumping
centers that can serve as sentinels to detect the movement of salty groundwater. One such pumping center is
the JCSA Owens-Illinois well field located approximately 0.75mi north of Toano Middle School. VDEQ would
like to install a groundwater monitoring well on the property of Toano Middle School. The easements are
typically 10-feet by 10-feet. DEQ will maintain the well and the area within the easement.
To proceed with the project, the Williamsburg-James City County School Board is being asked to grant
permanent easement that will impose restrictions on the use of a portion of 7817 Richmond Road in the
Powhatan District of James City County, Virginia.
RATIONALE:
At no cost to the school board, this conveyance and easement grants Virginia Department of Environmental
Quality permanent access to school board property at 7817 Richmond Road, Toano VA 23168.
SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCE(S):
That for the sum of Ten Dollars ($10.00) and other valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which
are hereby acknowledged, Grantor (WJCC Schools) grants unto Grantee (VDEQ), its successors and assigns,
the perpetual, non-exclusive right, privilege, and easement (the “Easement”), to lay, erect, construct, install,
operate, maintain and repair a groundwater monitoring station and all equipment, accessories and
appurtenances necessary in connection therewith (the “Facilities”) over, under, upon, and across the lands of
the Grantor.
COST BUDGETED:
No funding is requested from the board.
ALTERNATIVES:
1. Approve the superintendent’s recommendation.
2. Do not approve the superintendent’s recommendation.



SUPERINTENDENT’S RECOMMENDATION:
The superintendent recommends the board approve this request for permanent easement at Toano Middle
School, James City County Real Estate Tax Parcel No. 1240100051, to Virginia Department of Environmental
Quality as presented.
DATA SOURCE:
Marcellus Snipes, Senior Director for Operations
RECOMMENDED ACTION:
Move to approve the request for granting permanent easement at Toano Middle School, James City County
Real Estate Tax Parcel No. 1240100051, to the Virginia Department of Environmental Quality as presented.

items.title: Approval of Request for Permanent Easements at Clara Byrd Baker Elementary School of Real Property to James City County
items.body:
MEETING DATE:
8/18/2026
TOPIC:
Approve Request for Permanent Easements at Clara Byrd Baker Elementary School, James City County Real
Estate Tax Parcel No. 4710100058, of Real Property to James City County
POLICY ALIGNMENT:
BBA, School Board Powers and Duties
BACKGROUND:
The James City County Division of Stormwater & Resource Protection is requesting that WJCC Schools
provide an easement in perpetuity. The request is to support the Chesapeake Bay Preservation Ordinance,
Chapter 23 of the James City County Code. The requirement by Article 2.5 of Chapter 3.1 of Title 62.1 of the
Code of Virginia protects the Chesapeake Bay and its tributaries from nonpoint source pollution within the
Chesapeake Bay drainage.
In recognition of the foregoing and in consideration of the sum of Ten Dollars ($10.00), WJCC Schools grants
an easement in perpetuity. The easement will preserve land as natural open space as part of efforts to improve
the quality of Stormwater runoff from the property.
In order to proceed with the project, the Williamsburg-James City County School Board is being asked to grant
a permanent easement that will impose restrictions on the use of a portion of 3131 Ironbound Road in the
Berkeley District of James City County, Virginia consisting of a tract of land containing 25.72 acres, identified
as James City County Real Estate Tax Parcel No. 4710100058.
RATIONALE:
At no cost to the school board, this conveyance and easement grants James City County permanent access to
school board property at 3131 Ironbound Road.
SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCE(S):
This includes conveyance of certain real property totaling 25.72 acres of permanent easement to restrict
construction of buildings, signs, billboard, outdoor advertisements, road or utility lines on easement without
express written consent by the County Watershed Planner, require easement to be kept free and clear of any
junk, trash, rubbish, unsightly or offensive material, to limit activities that remove or damage any vegetation or
soil without express written consent by the County Watershed Planner.
COST BUDGETED:
No funding is requested from the board. The project will be conducted by consultants, overseen by James City
County General Services staff, and ongoing maintenance will be provided by the County.
ALTERNATIVES:
1. Approve the superintendent’s recommendation.
2. Do not approve the superintendent’s recommendation.
SUPERINTENDENT’S RECOMMENDATION:



The superintendent recommends that the school board approve this request for granting a permanent
easement at James City County Real Estate Tax Parcel No. 4710100058, to James City County as presented.
DATA SOURCE:
Marcellus Snipes, Senior Director for Operations
RECOMMENDED ACTION:
Move to approve the request for granting a permanent easement at James City County Real Estate Tax Parcel
No. 4710100058, to James City County as presented.
